productDetails.name: ADDITIONAL_DETAILS
productDetails.value:
🇭🇰 It WILL NOT WORK in Hong Kong and Taiwan unless:

As per the law, registration is required to use when in Hong Kong. Please follow the steps below carefully to qualify for quick auto-registration:

  • Open the link below with your phone while connected to network with eSIM
  • Scan your passport
  • Do not modify the auto-fill

Deviating from the recommended steps above will send the request for manual review which will take not less than 24 hours.

Official registration website: https://www.three.com.hk/prepaid/account/en/rnr-reg

Taiwan-only quick registration website: https://www.three.com.hk/prepaid/account/en/tw-rnr

* Registration is not required for using the eSIM outside of Hong Kong and Taiwan.
